annotations.title: Read and check a UPI link

description: Read a UPI payment link (the upi://pay… text inside a payment QR code) and check it: who gets paid, the amount, the note and any merchant fields, with warnings about anything malformed or risky, such as an AutoPay mandate posing as a payment. Use it before paying from a QR someone sent, or to find out why apps reject a QR.

link.description: The upi://pay?… link, e.g. the text decoded from a QR code.
